title: dentaria integrifolia var. cardiophylla
intro: Dentaria integrifolia var. cardiophylla, commonly known as the Heart-leaf Toothwort, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in relieving digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Heart-leaf Toothwort include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful for treating coughs, bronchitis, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Dentaria integrifolia var. cardiophylla include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
